about.description: Off the beaten path on Canal Road in Orange Beach, Cosmo's Restaurant & Bar is far from ordinary. Serving fresh and eclectic food since day one, Cosmo's features a wide range of dining with chef-inspired ingredients including hand-cut steaks, local seafood, and pasta. A neighborhood favorite on the Gulf Coast that has taken cuisine to the cutting edge with variations of local staples.
about.elevator_pitch: Far from ordinary neighborhood restaurant on Alabama's Gulf Coast serving fresh, eclectic cuisine with chef-inspired ingredients.
about.vibe: Upscale casual dining with distinctive, innovative cuisine; off-the-beaten-path destination on the Gulf Coast
about.insider_tip: The Banana Leaf Wrapped Fish was named one of 'the top 100 dishes to eat before you die' by The Year of Alabama Food
